text:
Aisha N.: Hey @people-ops — my contractor payout hit today but 24% backup withholding was applied. I submitted a W-9 with ITIN on Oct 10, can someone check why?
Sophia (People Ops): Sorry about that, @Aisha. Can you drop the invoice ID or screenshot of the payment line so payroll can pull the file?
Aisha N.: Invoice INV-2024-118. Payment confirmation shows:
```
Payee: Aisha N.
Invoice: INV-2024-118
Gross: $5,000.00
Federal backup withholding: 24% $1,200.00
Net paid: $3,800.00
Payment method: ACH contractor
```
Payroll Bot: Ticket created: PAY-2025 assigned to @Diego (Payroll). Priority: high.
Diego (Payroll): Looking now. Our file for 2024-11-30 marked the payee as TIN flag = MISSING at time of file creation -> auto-apply backup withholding.
Diego (Payroll): Possible cause: W-9 was uploaded to HR but the contractor-platform mapping didn’t flip the "TIN verified" flag. Recruiting Ops, did the connector show any errors around Oct 10?
Recruiting Ops: We uploaded W-9 PDF on Oct 10 and saw a failed webhook to contractor-platform for ~6 records on that day. We fixed the connector on Oct 15 but didn't backfill. Opening infra ticket to backfill.
Diego (Payroll): If ACH is still pending we can stop remittance; if settled we will need to do an off-cycle ACH credit to the contractor and then pursue reclaim with IRS (Form 945 process).
Aisha N.: I need to be made whole now if possible — prefer payroll credit instead of waiting on IRS reclaim.
Manager - Jeff: Agreed — please prioritize the off-cycle credit for contractor experience.
Tax Team: Note: backup withholding is federal and, if remitted, will be reconciled via Form 945. For remediation we recommend payroll credit to the contractor immediately and Tax will open a reclaim with the IRS. If reclaim succeeds, company keeps the credit flow tidy; if not, contractor gets docs to claim a credit on their return.
Diego (Payroll): Checking bank status now. If ACH settled Ill schedule off-cycle credit tomorrow morning for $1,200 and include W-9 copy in notes. If pending Ill try to stop the remittance.
Diego (Payroll): Update: ACH settled at 09:42. Scheduling off-cycle ACH credit for tomorrow 08:00. Will attach W-9 and explanation memo.
Sophia (People Ops): Action items:
• @Diego schedule off-cycle ACH credit (PAY-2025)
• @Recruiting Ops backfill the connector and confirm TIN flag fixes for the affected hires
• @Tax Team start IRS reclaim workflow and advise on Form 945 reporting
• @Diego add note to contractor record and email Aisha copy of docs
Aisha N.: Thank you. Please CC me on PAY-2025 and any forms I need. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :pray:
Diego (Payroll): Will do — Ill post a confirmation here when the credit clears and close PAY-2025. :white_check_mark:
Tax Team: We'll also update internal runbook to double-check connector status before contractor payouts for the next two payroll cycles.
